## Data change checklist

- [ ] Question IDs are unique and stable.
- [ ] English/Hindi wording has been reviewed.
- [ ] Correct answer and explanation were checked against a reliable source.
- [ ] Source URL, publisher, access date, and license/terms are recorded.
- [ ] No copyrighted question bank was copied without permission.
- [ ] For time-sensitive facts, the as-of date is clear.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_database.py` passes locally.
